mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT saur.recommend_open_id, saur.recommended_open_id, saur.create_time FROM sys_applet_user_recommend saur WHERE saur.recommend_open_id = #{openId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.create_time BETWEEN saur.create_time AND '2025-08-31 23:59:59' AND ci.open_id = saur.recommended_open_id AND o.status = 'PAID' and paid_amount >= 360 )
